objective: Choose between the Import Wizard and Data Loader
stem: What is the maximum number of records the Data Import Wizard can import at one time?
explanation: The Data Import Wizard handles up to 50,000 records at a time. Data Loader is the tool for much larger loads, up to 5 million records.

objective: Choose between the Import Wizard and Data Loader
stem: Khanyisa Solar needs to load 2 million records into Salesforce. Which tool should the admin use?
explanation: Data Loader supports up to 5 million records. The Data Import Wizard stops at 50,000 records.

objective: Choose between the Import Wizard and Data Loader
stem: A sales assistant who is not technical needs to import 300 leads from a spreadsheet and avoid creating duplicates by matching on email. Which tool fits best?
explanation: The Data Import Wizard is browser-based, simple to use, and can match on fields such as email to avoid duplicates. It suits small one-off loads.

objective: Choose between the Import Wizard and Data Loader
stem: Which object CANNOT be imported with the Data Import Wizard?

options.text: Leads, which can be imported with the wizard
Accounts, which can be imported with the wizard
Contacts, which can be imported with the wizard

explanation: The wizard supports accounts, contacts, leads, campaign members, solutions, person accounts and custom objects. Opportunities and cases need Data Loader.

objective: Describe Data Loader operations
stem: An admin must delete 30,000 old records in bulk using a tool with a file of record IDs. Which tool should she use?
explanation: The Data Import Wizard cannot delete. Data Loader supports delete and hard delete.

objective: Describe Data Loader operations
stem: Which TWO operations does Data Loader support that the Data Import Wizard does not? (Choose 2)
explanation: Both tools can insert and update. Only Data Loader can export, delete and hard delete.

objective: Describe Data Loader operations
stem: What does an upsert operation do?

options.text: Updates a record if a match is found and inserts a new one if not
Deletes a record and recreates it with the new values
Inserts every row even if a matching record already exists
Moves matching records to the Recycle Bin and adds new ones

explanation: Upsert is a combination of update and insert. It uses a record ID or an external ID to decide which one to do for each row.

objective: Explain record IDs and external IDs
stem: An admin wants to update 500 existing accounts using Data Loader. Which column must the CSV file contain?
explanation: Updates match existing records by record ID. Without it, Data Loader does not know which records to change.

objective: Explain record IDs and external IDs
stem: What is the main benefit of marking a custom field as an External ID?

options.text: You can match and upsert records using a key from another system without knowing Salesforce IDs
The field becomes visible to external users on the Experience Cloud site, and can be searched
The field is automatically encrypted when it is saved, so it is protected from other users
The field cannot be edited after the record is created, which keeps every key stable

explanation: An external ID holds a unique key from another system (such as a customer number). It lets you match records for upsert and link children to parents without looking up Salesforce record IDs.

objective: Describe Data Loader operations
stem: What does a hard delete in Data Loader do?

options.text: Permanently removes records without sending them to the Recycle Bin
Moves records to the Recycle Bin, where they stay for 15 days
Deletes only the field values and keeps the empty records
Archives the records so that they can be restored later by an admin

explanation: Hard delete bypasses the Recycle Bin, so the records cannot be restored. It needs the Bulk API Hard Delete permission.

objective: Describe Data Loader operations
stem: Which user permission is required before a hard delete can be performed with Data Loader?
explanation: No user has the Bulk API Hard Delete permission by default. An admin must grant it, usually through a permission set.

objective: Describe Data Loader operations
stem: What is the difference between Export and Export All in Data Loader?

options.text: Export All also includes records in the Recycle Bin
Export All exports every object at once

explanation: Export returns existing records. Export All also returns soft-deleted records still in the Recycle Bin.

objective: Describe Data Loader operations
stem: A user needs to use Data Loader. Which setting must be enabled on their profile or permission set?
explanation: Data Loader connects through the API, so the user needs the API Enabled permission as well as access to the objects.

objective: Choose between the Import Wizard and Data Loader
stem: Which statement about how Data Loader matches records is true?

options.text: It matches by record ID or external ID only
It matches by name or email like the Import Wizard
It matches automatically on every text field
It never matches and only inserts

explanation: Data Loader uses IDs or external IDs. It does not look for similar names or emails, so duplicates are a risk unless duplicate rules or a clean file prevent them.

objective: Run a safe import
stem: Contact rows fail to import because the related accounts do not exist yet. What is the best fix?

options.text: Load the accounts first, then load the contacts linked by ID or external ID
Turn off every validation rule and load the contacts again
Use the Data Export Service to move the accounts
Merge the contacts into one record before loading

explanation: Child records point at parents, so parents must exist first. Load accounts, then contacts, then opportunities.

objective: Prepare a clean import file
stem: A record is imported without an owner column. Who owns the new record?

options.text: The user who ran the import

explanation: If you do not provide an owner, the records are owned by the user running the import.

objective: Prepare a clean import file
stem: Some rows in an import fail with validation rule error messages. What is the likely reason?

options.text: Validation rules run on imported records just as they do for manual saves
Data Loader is broken and needs to be reinstalled
The CSV file was too large for the tool to process
Validation rules are only used in the user interface and never on imports

explanation: Validation rules fire wherever a record is saved: the UI, imports, flows and the API. Fix the data or plan the load around the rules.

objective: Run a safe import
stem: What should an admin do first before running a bulk update on 10,000 existing records?

options.text: Export the records to keep a copy of the current values
Run the update straight away and fix problems afterwards
Delete the records and re-import them

explanation: Exporting first gives you a rollback copy. There is no undo for a bulk update.

objective: Run a safe import
stem: Where should a new, untested import process be tried first?

options.text: In a sandbox or developer org with a small sample
In production with all records, so the result is real
In production overnight when fewer users are logged in
Only in a spreadsheet, by checking the formulas

explanation: Test with a few rows in a sandbox, then check the results, validation behaviour and automation side effects before loading production.

objective: Use mass transfer, mass delete and merge
stem: A sales rep leaves the company. The admin must reassign her 400 accounts to another rep in one step. Which tool is designed for this?
explanation: Mass Transfer Records moves many records between owners. It supports accounts, leads, campaigns, service contracts and custom objects.

objective: Use mass transfer, mass delete and merge
stem: Which TWO object types can be moved in bulk with Mass Transfer Records? (Choose 2)
explanation: Mass Transfer Records covers accounts, leads, campaigns, service contracts and custom objects. For opportunities and cases use a list view or Data Loader.

objective: Use mass transfer, mass delete and merge
stem: How many duplicate records can be merged into one in a single merge?
explanation: You can merge up to three accounts, contacts or leads at a time. You choose the master record.

objective: Use mass transfer, mass delete and merge
stem: How long are deleted records kept in the Recycle Bin before being permanently removed?
explanation: Deleted records stay in the Recycle Bin for 15 days and can be restored in that time.

objective: Explain the ways to back up data
stem: Which built-in tool packages your org's data into CSV files on a weekly or monthly schedule for backup?
explanation: The Data Export Service (Setup > Data Export) creates CSV files of your data and emails a download link.

objective: Explain the ways to back up data
stem: After a Data Export Service run, how long do the files stay available for download?
explanation: The download link in the email is valid for 48 hours, then the files are deleted. Download them promptly.

objective: Explain the ways to back up data
stem: An admin says, "We have weekly Data Export files, so we can restore the org in one click." What is wrong with this statement?

options.text: Data Export provides CSV backup files, not an automatic restore
Data Export cannot be scheduled, so it has to be run by hand
Data Export only includes setup data and not records
Data Export files expire after 24 hours so cannot be restored

explanation: The export is a backup. Restoring means re-importing the files. Dedicated backup products such as Salesforce Backup and Restore offer restore.

objective: Choose between the Import Wizard and Data Loader
stem: Which option lets an admin schedule a regular, automated export of one object from the command line?
explanation: Data Loader can run from the command line, which lets you schedule jobs such as a nightly export.

objective: Choose an import tool
stem: A company has 200,000 accounts to load, with some already in Salesforce that must be updated by external ID. Which tool is best?
explanation: Data Loader handles large volumes and upsert by external ID. The wizard has a lower record limit.
